emails.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

Thank you for your renewal proposal and for explaining the context behind it. To build a stable basis for our continued cooperation, could you outline the scope within your existing approval authority for a longer agreement, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 423.56, payment_days 14, contract_months 36, volume_per_year 4580; unit_price 425.06, payment_days 30, contract_months 36, volume_per_year 4580; unit_price 426.49, payment_days 45, contract_months 36, volume_per_year 4580). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
